shared_elements: low-relief carved surface divided into bands/registers
stylized floral/palmette motifs repeated in series
linear framing borders separating decorated zones
justification: Both surfaces use a strip of identical, evenly spaced rosette/palmette ornaments running along a framing band, rendered in the same shallow, highly conventionalized relief manner with crisp outlines and repeated units. The decisive difference is content: A is dominated by figural processions of standing human figures in profile and animals in stacked horizontal registers, while B shows only a vertical vegetal border of linked lotus-and-palmette forms against a blank field, with no figures at all.
